title: QuizArena — English Levels
description: Kuis Bahasa Inggris 10 level bertingkat. Pilih level, jawab 30 soal, dan kumpulkan poin!

levels.name: Kata Dasar & Warna
levels.desc: Kosakata paling dasar: benda, warna, dan angka.

levels.name: Kata Sehari-hari
levels.desc: Kata umum sehari-hari: keluarga, tempat, dan waktu.

levels.name: Lawan Kata
levels.desc: Latihan lawan kata (antonim) yang sering dipakai.

levels.name: Artikel & Jamak
levels.desc: Artikel a/an dan bentuk jamak kata benda.

levels.name: To Be & This/That
levels.desc: Kata kerja to be dan this/that/these/those.

levels.name: Simple Present
levels.desc: Simple present: akhiran -s/-es dan do/does.

levels.name: Continuous & Preposisi
levels.desc: Present continuous (-ing) dan preposisi in/on/at.

levels.name: Past Tense
levels.desc: Kata kerja bentuk lampau (past tense).

levels.name: Comparative & Modals
levels.desc: Comparative, superlative, dan modal verbs.

levels.name: Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
levels.desc: Idiom, phrasal verb, dan kosakata tingkat mahir.

levels.name: Kata Ganti & Kepemilikan
levels.desc: Subject, object, possessive adjective & pronoun.

levels.name: Kata Tanya (WH Questions)
levels.desc: What, where, when, who, why, how, whose, which.

levels.name: There is/are & Some/Any
levels.desc: There is/are, some/any, much/many, countable.

levels.name: Future Tense
levels.desc: Will dan be going to untuk masa depan.

levels.name: Present Perfect
levels.desc: have/has + V3, already/yet/ever/since/for.

levels.name: Adverbs & Frekuensi
levels.desc: Adverb of manner (-ly) & adverb of frequency.

levels.name: Kata Hubung (Conjunctions)
levels.desc: and, but, or, so, because, although, when, if.

levels.name: Conditional Sentences
levels.desc: If clause tipe 0, 1, dan 2.

levels.name: Passive Voice
levels.desc: Kalimat pasif: be + V3 (present & past).

levels.name: Reported Speech & Campuran
levels.desc: Reported speech, relative & review mahir.
